API Reference

REST API v1

Base URL: https://api.signalforge.io/v1  ·  All responses are JSON  ·  All timestamps are UTC ISO 8601

Authentication

All API requests must include a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Generate tokens from your workspace settings at app.signalforge.io/settings/tokens.

Authentication header bash 
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sfk_live_01HXK9F2J8ABCDEF" \
  https://api.signalforge.io/v1/status
HeaderValue
Authorization Bearer <token> — required on all requests
Content-Type application/json — required for POST/PATCH requests
SF-Workspace-ID Optional. Override workspace context for multi-workspace tokens.
Token scopes

Production tokens have prefix sfk_live_. Test tokens (sfk_test_) are rate-limited and only affect your test workspace. Never embed a live token in client-side code.

Monitors

GET /v1/monitors List monitors

Returns a paginated list of all monitors in your workspace, ordered by creation date descending.

Query parameters

limit
integer
Number of results per page. Default: 20, max: 100.
cursor
string
Pagination cursor from previous response's next_cursor field.
status
string
Filter by status: active, paused, or muted.
tag
string
Filter by tag key-value pair, e.g. tier:tier-1.

Example request

bash 
$ curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sfk_live_01HXK9F2J8" \
  "https://api.signalforge.io/v1/monitors?limit=5&status=active" \
  | jq '.'

Response

json 
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id":          "mon_01HXK8A2BC",
      "name":        "Payments API Health",
      "type":        "http",
      "url":         "https://api.acme.io/v1/health",
      "interval_s":  30,
      "status":      "active",
      "last_check":  "2024-03-12T14:36:50Z",
      "last_result": "ok",
      "uptime_7d":   99.94,
      "tags": {
        "team": "payments",
        "tier": "tier-1"
      },
      "created_at":  "2024-01-08T09:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total":       12,
    "limit":       5,
    "next_cursor": "cur_01HXM2A9ZP"
  }
}
POST /v1/monitors Create a monitor

Creates a new monitor. Returns the created monitor object with its assigned ID.

Request body

name required
string
Human-readable monitor name. Max 120 characters.
type required
string
Monitor type: http, tcp, ssl, or dns.
url required
string
Target URL (http/https). Required for http and ssl types.
interval_s
integer
Check interval in seconds. Min: 30 (free tier), 10 (paid). Default: 60.
timeout_s
integer
Request timeout in seconds. Default: 10, max: 30.
regions
array
Regions to probe from. Options: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Default: ["us-east-1"].
expect
object
Expected response criteria. See expect object.
tags
object
Key-value pairs for grouping and filtering. All values must be strings.

Example request

bash 
$ curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sfk_live_01HXK9F2J8" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name":       "Auth Service Health",
    "type":       "http",
    "url":        "https://auth.acme.io/health",
    "interval_s": 30,
    "timeout_s":  5,
    "regions":    ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
    "expect": {
      "status":        200,
      "latency_p95_ms": 1500
    },
    "tags": { "team": "platform", "tier": "tier-1" }
  }' \
  https://api.signalforge.io/v1/monitors

Response 201 Created

json 
{
  "id":          "mon_01HXM2A9ZP",
  "name":        "Auth Service Health",
  "type":        "http",
  "url":         "https://auth.acme.io/health",
  "interval_s":  30,
  "timeout_s":   5,
  "regions":     ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
  "status":      "active",
  "expect": {
    "status":         200,
    "latency_p95_ms": 1500
  },
  "tags": {
    "team": "platform",
    "tier": "tier-1"
  },
  "created_at":  "2024-03-12T15:00:00Z"
}
DELETE /v1/monitors/{id} Delete a monitor

Permanently deletes a monitor and all associated signal history. This action cannot be undone.

bash
$ curl -s -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sfk_live_01HXK9F2J8" \
  https://api.signalforge.io/v1/monitors/mon_01HXM2A9ZP

HTTP/2 204 No Content

Signals

GET /v1/signals List signals

Returns recent signals across all monitors in your workspace. Supports filtering by monitor, severity, type, and time range.

Query parameters

monitor_id
string
Filter signals to a specific monitor.
severity
string
critical, warning, or info.
state
string
firing, acknowledged, resolved, or muted.
since
string
ISO 8601 timestamp. Return signals after this time.
limit
integer
Results per page. Default: 50, max: 500.

Example: get all firing critical signals

bash
$ curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sfk_live_01HXK9F2J8" \
  "https://api.signalforge.io/v1/signals?state=firing&severity=critical"

Signal object

json
{
  "id":                  "sig_01HXK9F2J8",
  "monitor_id":          "mon_01HXK8A2BC",
  "monitor_name":        "Payments API Health",
  "type":                "status_not_2xx",
  "severity":            "critical",
  "state":               "resolved",
  "value":               503,
  "threshold":           "2xx",
  "consecutive_failures": 4,
  "regions_affected":    ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
  "first_seen":          "2024-03-12T14:32:18Z",
  "last_seen":           "2024-03-12T14:36:32Z",
  "resolved_at":         "2024-03-12T14:36:50Z",
  "duration_s":          272,
  "metadata": {
    "environment": "production",
    "tags": { "team": "payments", "tier": "tier-1" }
  }
}

Webhooks

Webhooks deliver signal payloads to your endpoint in real time. SignalForge signs every request with HMAC-SHA256 using your webhook secret, allowing you to verify authenticity.

POST /v1/webhooks Create a webhook destination
bash
$ curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sfk_live_01HXK9F2J8" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "url":          "https://hooks.acme.io/signalforge",
    "description":  "Acme internal incident handler",
    "on_severity":  ["critical", "warning"],
    "on_events":    ["signal.fired", "signal.resolved"]
  }' \
  https://api.signalforge.io/v1/webhooks

Webhook payload format

SignalForge POSTs a JSON payload to your endpoint whenever a matching event occurs. The delivery includes a signature header for verification.

Incoming webhook request headers http 
POST /signalforge HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.acme.io
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: SignalForge/1.0
SF-Signature: sha256=3e5f4b1c2a7d...
SF-Event: signal.fired
SF-Delivery: del_01HXK9F2J8GHIJK
Webhook payload — signal.fired json 
{
  "event":       "signal.fired",
  "delivery_id": "del_01HXK9F2J8GHIJK",
  "timestamp":   "2024-03-12T14:32:49Z",
  "signal": {
    "id":                  "sig_01HXK9F2J8",
    "type":                "status_not_2xx",
    "severity":            "critical",
    "value":               503,
    "threshold":           "2xx",
    "consecutive_failures": 2,
    "first_seen":          "2024-03-12T14:32:18Z"
  },
  "monitor": {
    "id":   "mon_01HXK8A2BC",
    "name": "Payments API Health",
    "url":  "https://api.acme.io/v1/health"
  },
  "workspace": {
    "id":   "ws_01HX3K9F2J",
    "name": "acme-platform"
  },
  "metadata": {
    "environment": "production",
    "regions":     ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
    "tags": { "team": "payments", "tier": "tier-1" }
  }
}

Error codes

HTTPCodeDescription
400invalid_requestRequest body failed schema validation. Check the errors array in the response.
401unauthorizedMissing or invalid Bearer token.
403forbiddenToken does not have permission for this operation or resource.
404not_foundResource does not exist or belongs to a different workspace.
409conflictResource with this ID or name already exists.
422unprocessableSemantically invalid — e.g., interval below tier minimum.
429rate_limitedExceeded rate limit. See Retry-After header.
500internal_errorSignalForge error. The request_id field can be shared with support.
Error response shapejson
{
  "error":      "invalid_request",
  "message":    "Validation failed",
  "request_id": "req_01HXK9F2J8XYZ",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field":   "interval_s",
      "message": "Minimum interval for free tier is 30 seconds"
    }
  ]
}
